script.lua.help.text:
━━━ Lua Script API Quick Reference ━━━

[Available API]
  hmi_read(variable_id)      Read variable value
  hmi_write(variable_id, val) Write variable value
  hmi_set_control_property(ctrl_id, prop, val)  Modify control property

[Preset Categories]
  OnClick       — Button click event
  OnValueChanged — Variable value changed event
  Timer          — Periodic timer
  Alarm          — Alarm linkage

[Shortcuts]
  Ctrl+S  Save script
  F5       Syntax check
  F6       Debug run (sandbox)

[Debug Run Notes]
  - Execute function body in sandbox, reusing project variables and preview simulation values
  - hmi_read("x") reads variable, hmi_write("x", v) writes variable
  - hmi_set_control_property does not take effect in debug run
  - Supports if/then/else/end branches and arithmetic comparison expressions

[Notes]
  - Each script must contain at least one function
  - Function name must match the bound event
  - Supports Lua 5.3 basic syntax
  - Use -- for single-line comments

cfg.note.LayoutSettings.ShowCommandBar: Nothing reads the command bar visibility flag: unchecking it leaves the command bar visible.
cfg.note.LayoutSettings.ShowMenu: Nothing reads the menu bar visibility flag: unchecking it leaves the menu bar visible.
cfg.note.LayoutSettings.AutoHidePanels: Panel auto-hide is not implemented: the panels behave exactly the same either way.
cfg.note.ThemeSettings.AccentColor: The real source of the accent colour is AppThemeService.CustomAccent; nothing reads this key.
cfg.note.InteractionSettings.EnableAnima: Editor animations are not connected to any animation path.
cfg.note.InteractionSettings.EnableUndoR: Undo/redo is always on; there is no path that turns it off.
cfg.note.InteractionSettings.UndoStackSi: The undo stack has no capacity limit (the 100 in UndoRedoManager's Stack is the initial capacity, not a cap).
cfg.note.InteractionSettings.ShowRulers: The canvas ruler feature does not exist.
cfg.note.InteractionSettings.EnableLiveP: Property edits always apply immediately; there is no apply-on-blur path.
cfg.note.DisplaySettings.DefaultFont: New controls still take their initial font from the control defaults; this value is not read.
cfg.note.DisplaySettings.FontStep: The property panel's font-size step is hard-coded and does not read this value.
cfg.note.DisplaySettings.CanvasBackgroun: The canvas background comes from the theme resource HmiBgWindow, so changing it here has no effect (the same colour is kept in three places).
cfg.note.DisplaySettings.ShowToolTips: Tool tip visibility is not wired up.
cfg.note.DisplaySettings.ShowPreviewOver: The preview overlay is not implemented.
cfg.note.ExportConfig.CodeStyle: The generator ignores code style: indentation and brace placement are fixed.
cfg.note.ExportConfig.ResourceNaming: Resource symbols are always snake_case (implemented solely in CResourceSymbols); there is no way to switch.
cfg.note.ExportConfig.MergeResources: Resource bundling is not implemented: images and fonts remain separate files.
cfg.note.ScreenDefaultsConfig.DefaultOri: Screen orientation is not used during generation; the target runtime is fixed at 1024x600 landscape.
cfg.note.RuntimeConfig.HistoryStoragePat: Persisting history data is not implemented.
cfg.note.RuntimeConfig.WatchdogTimeoutMs: The watchdog timeout is not pushed to the firmware (only the scan interval and the log level actually reach the device).
cfg.note.RuntimeConfig.HeartbeatInterval: The heartbeat interval is not pushed to the firmware.
cfg.note.RuntimeConfig.MaxRuntimeTasks: The runtime task limit is not implemented.
cfg.note.VariableManager.DefaultScanInte: The connection config does not inherit this default scan interval; changing it affects no channel.
cfg.note.VariableManager.DefaultTimeoutM: The connection config does not inherit this default timeout.
cfg.note.VariableManager.MaxRetryCount: The connection config does not inherit this default retry count.
cfg.note.VariableManager.RetryBackoffMs: The connection config does not inherit this default retry backoff.
cfg.note.VariableManager.EnableWriteCoal: The write-coalescing switch is not connected to the communication layer.
cfg.note.VariableManager.ConnectionRecov: The reconnection recovery strategy is not connected to the communication layer.
